Our aim is to bring AI into the discovery loop—connecting the structure of quantum problems with new algorithms, better codes, and a deeper understanding of computational resources.

+ 03 / OUR APPROACH

AI explores.
Rigor decides.

A proposed research loop that pairs
machine exploration with mathematical
and computational scrutiny.

01 / FORMULATE↗

Find the structure.

Translate a problem into its algebraic, Fourier, or coding-theoretic representation.

02 / EXPLORE↗

Expand the search.

Use AI to propose candidate algorithms, code constructions, and research hypotheses.

03 / EVALUATE↗

Put ideas to the test.

Check correctness, simulate behavior, and compare resource costs against clear baselines.

04 / REFINE↺

Bring it back to theory.

Turn useful patterns into precise statements, reproducible experiments, and new questions.

+ 05 / THE LAB

A small beginning.
An open horizon.

Quantum Fourier Lab is an emerging research initiative at the intersection of artificial intelligence and quantum computation.

Drawing on Kaifeng Bu’s work in quantum Fourier analysis, decoding-driven algorithms, and quantum resources, we are shaping a foundation for research and future ventures.

We believe the next useful quantum algorithm may begin with a different question—and a better way to explore it.
